meri call har time drop ho jati hai
kya network area mein koi problem hai
mera net slow chal raha hai puri raat
kab se yeh problem aa rahi hai mujhe samajh nahi aa raha

bheja ho jata hoon baar baar par call connect nahi hota
kya aap logo ke server mein koi fault chal raha hai kya

items.context: Kya aapko call drop ya internet slow chalne mein problem aa rahi hai?
items.text: kya aap sambandh number provide kar sakte hain

items.context: Kya currently aap kisi specific jagah se call kar rahe hain?
items.text: main Mumbai mein hoon yaha to signal bahut weak hai

items.context: Aap kis date se is issue ko face kar rahe hain?
items.text: kal subah se network problem start hua abhi bhi hai

items.context: Kya aapne apne device ko restart karke dekha hai?
items.text: haan main phone restart kar chuka hoon par koi farq nahi pada
mera network baar baar chala jata hai jab main call karta hoon aur jab internet chalata hoon to bahut slow milta hai
main kal se Mumbai area mein hoon aur yahan network signal bahut weak hai matlab kuch bhi kaam nahi kar raha hai
kya aap log apne system mein koi update kar rahe hain ya fir koi technical issue ho raha hai mera data nahi chal raha

items.context: Kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki aapko call drop ki problem kab se ho rahi hai?
items.text: haan main bataana chahta tha ki call drop hona bahut zyada ho raha hai aur mai weekday pe office nahi ja paata

items.context: Aap apne internet speed ko lekar kya problem face kar rahe hain?
items.text: main ghar par hoon, lekin mera internet speed bahut slow ho gaya hai matlab whatsapp mein messages bhi load nahi hote

items.context: Kya aap mujhe apni location aur problem ka detail de sakte hain?
items.text: kya aap log network coverage check kar sakte hain mera area baar baar no signal dikha raha hai Tuesday nahi Wednesday se shayad

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: no_network - has no signal, call drops or slow internet
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
